Use this only when you want to start again with an empty journal. The command asks you to confirm.

:::caution
This command removes every entry from your reports and searches. The entries stay in the database until you restore them one by one. Export your journal first. Read the [backups guide](/gournal/docs/guides/data-safety-and-backups/).
:::

## CLI: gournal clear

Remove all journal entries after you confirm. This command needs a terminal.

```text
gournal clear
```

## Examples

### CLI

The command needs a terminal so that it can ask you to confirm. Without a terminal, it refuses and removes nothing. This example ran with the input redirected from `/dev/null`.

```console
$ gournal clear </dev/null
Not a terminal; nothing cleared.
```

The command exits with status 1.
